lyrics:
[00:00.00] [Instrumental Intro]
[Chorus]
[00:27.12] All through the midnight hours
[00:29.66] Runnin' from my fears, shit, I feel like a coward
[00:32.88] Kryptonite killed all of my superpowers
[00:35.88] My anxiety builds, I jump off the stress tower
[00:39.70] Reachin' for the pills, I take opiate showers
[00:43.08] Growin' from my sins that I'm planting in flowers
[00:46.04] Devil got me snortin' lines of enchantment powder
[00:49.84] Life is a bitch and her lips taste sour
[Verse 1]
[00:54.64] I find it fascinating that I'm high off my own supply
[01:02.10] Buckle up, it's gon' be a long ride
[01:05.58] Knuckle up, these demons came to fight
[01:08.16] Oh, run amok, 'mok, 'mok, cause a ruckus, oh
[01:12.26] Had enough, 'nough, 'nough, screamin' "Fuck this all"
[01:15.62] Yeah, fuck this all, life gets dirty, time for the Lysol
[01:21.12] Makin' crucial mistakes, yeah, I know it's my fault
[01:24.34] You hate to look at my face, yeah, I know it's my fault
[01:28.32] You don't gotta tell me, I know I'm the cause
[01:31.62] Surgery is needed, put away the gauze
[Chorus]
[01:34.34] All through the midnight hours
[01:37.16] Runnin' from my fears, shit, I feel like a coward
[01:40.48] Kryptonite killed all of my superpowers
[01:43.68] My anxiety builds, I jump off the stress tower
[01:47.32] Reachin' for the pills, I take opiate showers
[01:50.68] Growin' from my sins that I'm planting in flowers
[01:53.78] Devil got me snortin' lines of enchantment powder
[01:57.44] Life is a bitch and her lips taste sour
[Verse 2]
[02:01.66] Sometimes life flies over my head, yeah
[02:04.90] It's out of my hands, yeah, hard to comprehend that
[02:08.16] I fall to my knees, tell God "I'm calling it quits"
[02:11.20] Want out of the misery business, 'cause I can't take it
[02:14.80] Things ain't what they seem, they think it's easy to be me
[02:18.06] I never let them see me bleed, I only let them see peace
[02:21.60] Things ain't what they seem, they think it's easy to be me
[02:24.80] I never let them see me bleed nor see me in pieces
[02:28.44] I'm getting used to openin' up to people around me
[02:31.82] I know that they're my family, they would do anything to help me
[02:35.06] But they still don't know everything that is going on inside me
[02:38.54] Even I don't know all the places my demons are hiding
[Chorus]
[02:42.32] All through the midnight hours
[02:44.76] Runnin' from my fears, shit, I feel like a coward
[02:48.08] Kryptonite killed all of my superpowers
[02:51.10] My anxiety builds, I jump off the stress tower
[02:54.92] Reachin' for the pills, I take opiate showers
[02:58.28] Growin' from my sins that I'm planting in flowers
[03:01.40] Devil got me snortin' lines of enchantment powder
[03:05.06] Life is a bitch and her lips taste sour
title: Sour
author: Juice WRLD
